combo.config.title: Combo Settings
tooltip.combo.min_attack_strength: How charged an attack must be to build or continue a combo.
tooltip.combo.timeout_slack_ticks: Extra ticks allowed between hits, on top of the weapon's own cooldown, before the combo resets.
tooltip.combo.finisher_damage_multiplier: Damage multiplier applied to the 3rd (finisher) hit.
tooltip.combo.finisher_extra_knockback: Extra knockback strength applied on a finisher hit.
tooltip.combo.axe_knockback_multiplier: Extra multiplier applied on top of the finisher knockback when using an axe.
tooltip.combo.mace_knockback_multiplier: Extra multiplier applied on top of the finisher knockback when using a mace.
tooltip.combo.damage_popup_enabled: Whether floating damage numbers are shown above hit entities.
tooltip.combo.stagger_duration_ticks: How long a finisher staggers its target for.
tooltip.combo.stagger_slowness_amplifier: Slowness amplifier applied to a staggered target.
tooltip.combo.stagger_weakness_amplifier: Weakness amplifier applied to a staggered target.
tooltip.combo.stagger_visual_enabled: Whether staggered targets show an orbiting-star indicator.
tooltip.combo.sword_bleed_duration_ticks: How long a sword finisher's bleed effect lasts.
tooltip.combo.sword_bleed_amplifier: Bleed effect amplifier applied by a sword finisher.
tooltip.combo.mace_aoe_radius: Radius around the target that a mace finisher's splash damage reaches.
tooltip.combo.mace_aoe_damage: Flat damage dealt to entities caught in a mace finisher's splash radius.
tooltip.combo.parry_window_ticks: How recently you must have started blocking for a blocked hit to count as a parry.
tooltip.combo.parry_knockback: Knockback strength applied to an attacker on a successful parry.
tooltip.combo.parry_finisher_window_tick: How long after a successful parry your next landed hit is auto-upgraded to a finisher.
tooltip.combo.shield_block_delay_multipl: Scales vanilla's own shield-raise windup before it starts blocking. 100% is unchanged vanilla behavior, 0% blocks instantly.
tooltip.combo.backstab_damage_multiplier: Damage multiplier applied when sneaking and hitting a target from behind.
tooltip.combo.backstab_cone_degrees: Width of the arc behind a target, centered directly behind it, that counts as a backstab.
tooltip.combo.backstab_vignette_enabled: Whether a subtle vignette shows while sneaking, flashing red on a successful backstab.
tooltip.combo.sneak_visibility_multiplie: Extra multiplier on a mob's detection range when you're sneaking in its blind spot, on top of vanilla's own sneaking reduction. Lower is stealthier.
tooltip.combo.takedown_range: Distance within which a silent takedown can be performed on a target you're directly behind while Full Sneak Mode is active.
tooltip.combo.takedown_damage_multiplier: Damage multiplier applied on a silent takedown hit. Real damage through the normal pipeline, so weak hostiles die in one hit but tanky ones survive and take real damage.
tooltip.combo.full_sneak_mode_enabled: Whether sneaking grants drastically reduced detection in every direction, not just a target's blind spot, and enables silent takedowns.
tooltip.combo.full_sneak_omni_visibility: Extra multiplier on a mob's detection range, in every direction, while sneaking with Full Sneak Mode enabled. The blind spot is still stronger (full immunity). Lower is stealthier.
tooltip.combo.stamina_regen_per_tick: Stamina regained per tick once regen is active.
tooltip.combo.stamina_regen_delay_ticks: Ticks since the last stamina drain before regen starts.
tooltip.combo.stamina_sprint_drain_per_t: Stamina drained per tick while sprinting. Sprinting is force-stopped at 0 stamina.
tooltip.combo.stamina_block_drain_per_ti: Stamina drained per tick while blocking. Blocking is force-stopped at 0 stamina.
tooltip.combo.stamina_full_sneak_drain_p: Stamina drained per tick while Full Sneak Mode's detection bonus is active. The bonus stops applying at 0 stamina.
tooltip.combo.stamina_dodge_cost: Flat stamina cost to perform a dodge. Not enough stamina means the dodge fails.
tooltip.combo.stamina_parry_spike: One-time stamina cost on a successful parry. Drains unconditionally, doesn't block the parry.
tooltip.combo.stamina_finisher_spike: One-time stamina cost on a landed finisher hit. Drains unconditionally, doesn't block the hit.
tooltip.combo.stamina_takedown_spike: One-time stamina cost on a successful silent takedown. Drains unconditionally, doesn't block it.
tooltip.combo.dodge_strength: Horizontal impulse strength applied by a dodge.
tooltip.combo.dodge_invulnerability_tick: How long a dodge grants full damage immunity for.
tooltip.combo.dodge_cooldown_ticks: Minimum ticks between dodges, independent of stamina.
